To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the network approach is capable of assessing and predicting the effectiveness of carbon mitigation strategies by identifying nonzero-sum relationships between urban sectors and environment.

the dynamic network approach can be used to analyze the nonzero sum relationship of carbon emissions in urban systems.
